native_workflow:
name: Native Redis/PVA validation

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, 'dev/**']
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  native:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - runner: ubuntu-24.04
            sanitizer: none
          - runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            sanitizer: none
          - runner: macos-14
            sanitizer: none
          - runner: ubuntu-24.04
            sanitizer: address,undefined
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    # Linux ARM is a portability signal, not a 0.9.0 release platform.
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.runner == 'ubuntu-24.04-arm' }}
    timeout-minutes: 35
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
      - name: Fetch core dependencies
        run: git submodule update --init --recursive third_party/epics-base third_party/pvxs third_party/redis-adapter third_party/yaml-cpp
      - name: Install Linux build tools
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake perl libreadline-dev python3 redis-server
      - name: Install macOS build tools
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: brew install cmake readline redis
      - name: Install optional integrations for sanitizer coverage
        if: matrix.sanitizer != 'none'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y libgrpc++-dev libprotobuf-dev protobuf-compiler protobuf-compiler-grpc libcurl4-openssl-dev
      - name: Build pinned EPICS dependencies
        run: |
          make -C third_party/epics-base configure.install src.install -j4
          make -C third_party/epics-base/modules libcom.install -j4
          printf 'EPICS_BASE=%s/third_party/epics-base\n' "$PWD" > third_party/pvxs/configure/RELEASE.local
          make -C third_party/pvxs/bundle libevent
          make -C third_party/pvxs configure.install setup.install src.install tools.install -j4
      - name: Configure and build service
        env:
          SANITIZERS: ${{ matrix.sanitizer }}
          INTEGRATIONS: ${{ matrix.sanitizer == 'none' && 'OFF' || 'ON' }}
        run: |
          flags=""
          if test "$SANITIZERS" != none; then flags="-fsanitize=$SANITIZERS -fno-omit-frame-pointer"; fi
          cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug \
            -DREDIS_PVXS_IOC_ENABLE_GRPC="$INTEGRATIONS" -DREDIS_PVXS_IOC_ENABLE_CHANNELFINDER="$INTEGRATIONS" \
            -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="$flags" -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="$flags" -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="$flags"
          cmake --build build -j4
      - name: Test native runtime and access control
        env:
          ASAN_OPTIONS: detect_leaks=1
          UBSAN_OPTIONS: halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1
        run: ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
      - name: Check out the receiver acceptance dependency
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          repository: ChannelFinder/recsync
          ref: 864b162cb05fa140e67e056bda86ed750447c3d4
          path: build/recceiver-source
      - name: Test with real RecCeiver and its ChannelFinder processor
        run: |
          python3 -m venv build/recceiver-venv
          build/recceiver-venv/bin/python -m pip install -r tests/recceiver-requirements.txt
          build/recceiver-venv/bin/python scripts/run-with-redis.py --redis-server "$(command -v redis-server)" -- \
            build/recceiver-venv/bin/python tests/recceiver_acceptance.py \
            --source build/recceiver-source/server --ioc build/redis-pvxs-ioc \
            --pvxget "third_party/pvxs/bin/$(perl third_party/epics-base/lib/perl/EpicsHostArch.pl)/pvxget"
